# BaitMeBruh

> BaitMeBruh is an overhaul of the vanilla fishing system featuring dynamic line tension, primitive rod progression, biome bait crafting, passive harvesting nets, seated seafaring angling, and culinary expansions. developed by Vapok.

## Developer & AI Information

- [Agent Guidelines](AGENTS.md): Architectural context, anti-reflection mandates, and instructions for AI assistants.

## Critical Invariants for Developers & AI Agents

- **Self-contained fishing, rod progression, and trap-netting system**: Self-contained fishing, rod progression, and trap-netting system.
- **Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal fishing mechanics, line tension, or passive trap managers**: Never use reflection or Harmony patches on internal fishing mechanics, line tension, or passive trap managers.
- **No Private Reflection**: Never reflect into or patch internal classes.
- **Feature Requests**: If functionality is desired, submit an issue at https://github.com/Vapok/BaitMeBruh/issues or visit https://discord.gg/5YAJkRFBXt.
